|   `-- workspaceStorage?                       otherwise new WorkspaceStorage
|
|-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace                  owns session lifetimes
|   |-- store.drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|   |   |-- name / representationId? / revisionId / hidden? / busy
|   |   |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?  saved baseline for dirty checks
|   |   |-- viewport? / focusBox? / newerRevision?
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController
|   |       |   |-- diagrams / historyService    borrowed services
|   |       |   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext
|   |       |   |   `-- contextId                handle from historyService.openContext()
|   |       |   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
|   |       |   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version / canUndo / canRedo
|   |       |   |   |-- cell? / endpointBounds?   measured geometry
|   |       |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |       |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |       |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox     recursive placement tree
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- shared: id / position / collapsed / minimumSize?
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- diagram: contentId / collapsedContentId?
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   `-- container: children[] / push-right layout / gap
|   |       |   |   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: Diagram
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId / id / revision
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- content: ASCII / hash / diagram-or-tree structure

|   |       |   |   |   `-- edges[] / jumps? / sections
|   |       |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
|   |       |   |       |-- selection.items[]     membership and insertion order
|   |       |   |       |   `-- id / displayNodeId / region?
|   |       |   |       |       `-- captured source / rect / selectedIds
|   |       |   |       |-- diagramViews?         per-instance content folding
|   |       |   |       |-- display: DisplayState
|   |       |   |       |   |-- rootIds[] / nodes[id]: FloatingPane
|   |       |   |       |   |-- shared: childIds / expansion / pixel geometry
|   |       |   |       |   |           geometryPolicy / expandedGeometry?
|   |       |   |       |   `-- variants
|   |       |   |       |       |-- selection: captured region / activeChildId?
|   |       |   |       |       |-- projection: title / revision refs / content
|   |       |   |       |       |   `-- call-tree | compaction | source-code | code-panel
|   |       |   |       |       |-- conversation: thread / draft / canvasAnchor
|   |       |   |       |       |   `-- presentation: compact | floating | docked
|   |       |   |       |       `-- detail: title / ascii / sectionId?
|   |       |   |       `-- controls: activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|   |       |   |           `-- surfaces[id]: actions / prompt / ask / status
|   |       |   |-- nodes(): CanvasDisplayNode[]  derived read model; cloned and cached
|   |       |   |   |-- shared: id / version / childIds / expansion / collapsible
|   |       |   |   `-- layout variants
|   |       |   |       |-- grid: diagram | group
|   |       |   |       |   `-- boxId / cell bounds / content? / contentNodes? / diagram?
|   |       |   |       `-- floating: pane kinds above | arrow
|   |       |   |           |-- pixel geometry / value: FloatingBox
|   |       |   |           `-- placement variants
|   |       |   |               `-- grid-region | parent | conversation | stored
|   |       |   |                   connection: edgeId   arrows derive from edges[]
|   |       |   |-- applyUpdate(version, ops)     validates; stages; commits changes
|   |       |   |-- select() / updateCanvas() / commitDocument()
|   |       |   `-- undo() / exportHistory() / persistenceChanges() -> historyService
|   |       `-- readable stores                  publish controller references
|   |           |-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry
|   |           `-- status: isDirty / sceneDirty / canUndo / canRedo
|   |-- controllers[documentId]                  references session.controller
|   |-- changes.version / dirtyScenes.ids[]      derived notifications and indexes
|   |-- setDrafts()                              creates/replaces/disposes sessions
|   `-- copyDocument(...): { documentId }        forks history; clears selection
|
|-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState               owns live scroll and camera state
|   |-- entries[documentId][paneId] / cameras[documentId]
|   `-- captureDisplay() / captureCamera()       samples view state for persistence
|
|-- storage: WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- records: RecordStorage                  buffered record changes
|   `-- worker                                  load / project / write requests
|-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence           observes workspace and viewState
|   |-- sync(ids)                               controller.persistenceChanges(cursor)
|   |   `-- metadata / baseline / history / canvas / viewport -> records.batch()

|
|-- capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot         explicit full workspace snapshot
|   |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId? / transfers[]

|       |-- representationId / savedRepresentationId? / name / hidden?
|       |-- revisionId / savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?
|       |-- document / canvas / viewport?        current state plus sampled view
|       `-- history                             controller.exportHistory()
|
|-- activeId / mountedDocuments / pendingTransfer / transfers[]
|-- open() / restore()                          seed workspace sessions
|-- save()                                      save project diagram; update baseline
|-- transfer(copy | move) / undo(id, redo)
|   `-- prepare both histories -> storage.save() -> installWorkspace()
|-- workspaceAction(save | restore | export)    record flush / reload / serialize capture
|
|-- useAgentCanvasBridge(..., handleAgentCommand, workspace)
|   |-- context -> version / name / nodes() / edges
|   |-- snapshot -> ControllerSnapshot / history / saved IDs / name
|   `-- apply -> controller.transact()           shared applyUpdate command path
